lead: Building EMWD's $7.12M Goetz Road Trunk Sewer in Quail Valley (Menifee, northeast of Canyon Lake): a trunk sewer trenched along Goetz Rd, the same road as the yard, so the cut asphalt and trench spoils are only a few miles from Monarch.
notes: Source: Valley News, Mar 22, 2026 (EMWD board voted 5-0 on Mar 4 to award Weka $7,119,913). Brought up again Sept 24, 2026 when Valley News reported EMWD adopting the environmental report for the next Quail Valley sewer phase. This job isn't on Weka's record in the app yet. Ask the Goetz Rd superintendent about dumping broken AC and buying base to backfill the trench and patch the road.

lead: EMWD board certified the environmental report on Sept 16, 2026 for the Quail Valley Sub-Area 4 Septic-to-Sewer Project (Menifee), clearing the next phase of sewer lines in neighborhood streets to go to design and bid.
notes: Source: Valley News, Sept 24, 2026 (EMWD board 5-0, Sept 16). Quail Valley is about 10 miles from the yard. Street sewer work means trench cuts through asphalt and base for backfill and repaving. Ask EMWD engineering when Sub-Area 4 goes out to bid and get on the plan holder list so you can call the bidders.
